title: A Room That Is Not Ready
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A traveller discusses a delayed room and a practical alternative.

transcript.text: My room should be ready, but I have an online meeting at four. Is there somewhere quiet to use my laptop?
Sorry. The previous guest left late. You can use the meeting room for an hour; we will bring your bags up later.
That helps. I need reliable internet. Is the room connected to the guest network?
Yes, and I can extend checkout tomorrow by an hour to make up for the wait.
Thanks. I start early, so I may not use it. Please message me when ready.
Certainly. I will message you. The meeting room is just past the lounge.

questions.prompt: Why does the guest need a quiet place?
options: They have an online meeting soon.
They want to sleep before travelling.
They need to make a private phone call to the clerk.
They are waiting for a colleague to arrive.
questions.explanation: The guest says an online meeting is scheduled for four and asks for a quiet place to use a laptop.

questions.prompt: What caused the room to be late?
options: A technical problem with the internet
The guest arrived before check-in time
The previous guest left later than expected
Housekeeping could not find the bags
questions.explanation: The clerk explains that the previous guest left late and housekeeping is still finishing the room.

questions.prompt: What does the clerk offer immediately?
options: A different room for the whole night
Use of a meeting room for an hour
A meal while the guest waits
questions.explanation: The clerk offers the small meeting room for an hour so the guest can work while waiting.

questions.prompt: Why is the guest unsure about the later checkout?
options: They are leaving before the room is ready.
They already paid for an extra night.
They prefer to work in the meeting room.
They have an early start and may not need it.
questions.explanation: The guest accepts the option but says they have an early start and probably will not use it.
